name: Her Name Is Olgra
label: Quest
description: Her Name Is Olgra: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.
You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.
Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!
I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
